items.title: GUARD YOUR HEART
items.quote: The villainous fool says in his heart, ‘There is no G-d.’ They have acted corruptly and committed despicable acts. There is not one who does good.
items.text: It is not enough to behave properly. You must have a good attitude and emunah in Hashem; otherwise you will be like the villainous fool.

items.title: STRENGTH OF CHARACTER
items.quote: But all have turned away. They have gone foul together. There is no doer of good; there is not even one.
items.text: When your generation is being tested, stand up for what you believe in and do the right thing, even if it means going against everyone else.

items.title: ANTICIPATED JOY
items.quote: When Hashem restores the exiles of His people, Yaakov will exult, Yisrael will rejoice.
items.text: Have bitachon in the favorable outcome that Hashem has promised to those who are faithful to Him.
